critical_code_review_comments: TimePickerInline.tsx: FlatList → ScrollView migration is clean — data sets are tiny (12 hours, 60 minutes), snapToInterval + contentOffset preserved, debounced onScroll callback handles trackpad/mouse-wheel scrolling on react-native-web where onMomentumScrollEnd doesn't always fire. selectionLine correctly uses style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }} (the new RN style API) instead of the deprecated prop.

EmptyState.tsx: wrap uses flex:1 + alignItems:center + justifyContent:center — the right primitive for vertical centering. Caller (alarms tab + leaderboard tab) wraps it in emptyWrap {flex:1, minHeight:360, justifyContent:center} which guarantees a tall enough container even on small content areas. Result: center Y = 44.5% of viewport on both screens — squarely within the spec's 30-70% band.

reward.tsx: state hydration via recordChallengeWin() is idempotent for same-day re-entries (matches handoff context); awardXp gated by `advanced` flag prevents XP double-award on refresh; placeholderWeek() prevents empty render flash before AsyncStorage resolves. headline ternary correctly maps from='barcode' | 'photo' | 'math' → 'Barcode scanned!' / 'Photo captured!' / 'Math conquered!' (default is also Math conquered which is fine since /reward without param shouldn't be reachable in normal flow). Continue uses router.replace('/(main)') so user can't /back into the reward screen — good UX.

DayChip 3D treatment: filled (completed) chips render with bg=colors.primary, border=colors.primaryDark, borderBottomWidth=5 (CHIP_DEPTH) — matches the spec's '3D circular chips with white checkmark + bottom-border depth'. Today's chip when NOT yet filled gets a primary-orange ring via dayChipToday override — matches the 'primary-orange ring' requirement.

src/lib/streak.ts: clean isolation of streak + XP storage; trimHistory caps history at 28 entries; addDays uses Date arithmetic correctly (no DST bug since we go through Date constructor). buildCurrentWeek correctly anchors on Monday via `(dow + 6) % 7`. Storage layer is AsyncStorage-backed per the handoff context — Firestore migration deferred.

(main)/index.tsx + (main)/leaderboard.tsx: both wrap the EmptyState in an emptyWrap with `flex:1, minHeight:360, justifyContent:center` inside a ScrollView with `flexGrow:1` content container — this is the correct RN pattern for vertically centering empty-state content inside a scrollable container while keeping the title pinned at the top.

No HTML primitives used in any of the M6 files. All text wrapped in <Text>. All interactive elements have testIDs. Files are within size limits (TimePickerInline.tsx 253 lines, reward.tsx 245 lines, streak.ts 159 lines).
